comment: The two envelope outputs have no fixed range: DEVCore.cc:207-208 double the oscillator's 0V to 5V swing, multiply by the LEVEL knob read as -1 to +1, and add the OFFSET knob read as -10V to +10V, so the swing runs to 10V either way and can be shifted beyond that. The EOF B output is the inverse of a falling test rather than an end-of-fall pulse: DEVCore.cc:360 has it high whenever side B is not falling. Audio B normals to Audio A (DEVCore.cc:332-337) but the envelope sides are otherwise separate. The timing circuit is modelled at component level (DEVCore.cc:154-186), so no millisecond figures are stated here.
